agent_findings.subject: chassis/interior visibility over 1000-1180 on the reference run
agent_findings.finding: Dense evidence sheets (every 4 frames 1000-1180 plus every frame 1015-1040, zoomed raw and gamma-lifted crops) show the black chassis body clearly visible through the whole 1020-1171 window: rotated to its underside from ~1024 and partly under the fingers 1064-1171, never hidden. The grey interior block is partially visible only until ~1022 as the matte block protruding below the chassis plate between the two underside posts (the same surface the human accepted at frame 900); from ~1024 the region under the tracked interior mask is the chassis's own lower body, and a lighter grey inner surface reappears at the left/middle of the object from ~1128 (boxable at 1172). Sheets: runs/muggledsam-sam3-four-part-focused-corrections-agent-leak-20260918t004115z/agent_review/.

agent_findings.subject: leak-onset correction attempt (not adopted)
agent_findings.finding: Agent corrections at frame 1020 (chassis t001020-b02 candidate 0, 6876 px; interior t001020-b04 candidate 0, 1152 px on the protruding block; 12 px mutual overlap) were finalized under policy v4 and rerun as runs/muggledsam-sam3-four-part-static-focused-reassembly-static-c10379-20260918t004350z (2781 frames, 181.6 s, 2.21 GB peak VRAM). The interior slot re-leaks onto the chassis from ~1036-1046 along the same trajectory (interior IoU to the reference 0.90 over 1020-1070 and 0.98 over 1070-1110); chassis mean area 1338 vs 609 px over 1110-1172 but still <600 px on 29 frames; the reviewed 1172-1235 interior changed (IoU 0.77, mean 2325 vs 3089 px). The memory reset does not stop the leak because the interior's fresh memory is a block that disappears four frames later. The 001210z run stays the v4 reference; contact_eligible stays [0,1020) and [1172,1200).

agent_findings.finding: runs/wilor-hands-stabilized-20s-v5 applies the same bounded low-confidence lane-continuation gate as the first-minute layer. agent_findings.subject: DAM4SAM first-minute arm versus the corrected SAM3 reference (cross-method disagreement, not accuracy)
agent_findings.finding: runs/dam4sam-four-part-reviewed-seed-60s-20260918t005416z (same reviewed frame-0 seeds, frames [0,1800), 238.8 s, 7.32 GB peak VRAM, coverage 1800/1800/1780/1800, DRM additions 49/77/72/54). battle-segmentation-disagreement: mean IoU cabin 0.968, rear_body 0.786, chassis 0.678, interior 0.553; 16 episodes with IoU<0.5 for >=5 frames, the largest interior [707,1072) (DAM4SAM's independent interior stream merged onto the black chassis body, ~6.6k px vs SAM3's human-corrected ~1.4k), rear_body [1522,1661) (DAM4SAM mostly lost it, 20 missing frames), chassis [570,706), interior [1117,1252) and chassis [1055,1172) where DAM4SAM keeps a ~8.3k px chassis mask while the SAM3 reference has lost the chassis. Neither run is ground truth.
